values.note: Booked on the fair association's own online registration form (check-in date and nights); it asks whether the stay is part of a fairgrounds event and says to leave that blank if not, so ordinary campers book too. Deposits are non-refundable. Enter only at 3606 Blair Townhall Rd.

booking.source: https://www.northwesternmichiganfair.net/p/other/campground (Camping Registration form: 'Camping as part of an event? ... If not part of an event leave blank'; 'DEPOSITS on campsites are non-refundable'; 'ONLY ENTER AT 3606 BLAIR TOWNHALL RD.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Run by the Northwestern Michigan Fair Association (a nonprofit, not county government, so ownership=private) on the fairgrounds south of Traverse City; ordinary transient public camping, not events-only, except while the August fair is on. 130+ sites per directory listings. Livestock stalls and buildings on the grounds. --Claude
summary: Fair association's campground page: open May 15 - Oct 1, closed for the fair Aug 1-15 (two slightly different July dates given); 20/30/50 A on all sites, water spigots, bathrooms with showers, dump station, holding tanks emptied at the dump (no sewer); $43.50/night or $251.50/week including processing fees; online registration form open to non-event campers. Fees confirmed (now manual); electric 50 confirmed; sewer false, season dates, booking platform/url/note added. Phone 231-943-4150 and website match. Nearest gateway Sleeping Bear Dunes 37 km.
flags: Criteria check (fairgrounds): ordinary public nightly camping across the season is confirmed - the registration form books any check-in date and tells campers not attending an event to leave the event question blank. The campground closes during the fair (Aug 1-15), unlike 3984 Mason County Fairgrounds, which was fair-week-only.
Price gate: $43.50/night all-in on the operator's form, under US$50 (Sleeping Bear Dunes gateway 37 km anyway).
